### Summary of Changes

To address the Windows sandbox execution unreliability, permission inheritance issue, premature manifest cleanup, and failing integration tests, we have successfully implemented the following solutions:

1. **Improve Execution Synchronization & Safe Job Object Attachment in [GeminiSandbox.cs](file:///usr/local/google/home/joneba/ssr-prototype/gcli-intern-project/tools/caretaker-agent/evals/pr-generation/run_outputs/large_triaged_3.5_flash/agent_environments/gemini_cli_24480/tmp/pr/gemini-cli/packages/core/src/sandbox/windows/GeminiSandbox.cs):**
   - Configured process creation flags to spawn child processes with `CREATE_SUSPENDED`.
   - Assigned the suspended child process handle immediately to the Job Object prior to active execution.
   - Resumed the main thread of the child process using `ResumeThread`, which guarantees correct Job Object attachment before any third-party code executes.
   - Added rigorous check-and-log conditions with Win32 error codes for `CreateProcessAsUser`, `AssignProcessToJobObject`, and `SetInformationJobObject` calls.
   - Implemented a broad wrapper try/finally structure to perform exhaustive cleanups of process, thread, and Job Object handles, utilizing a fallback to `TerminateProcess` if the sandboxed process did not complete successfully.

2. **Refined Path Handling & Permissions in [WindowsSandboxManager.ts](file:///usr/local/google/home/joneba/ssr-prototype/gcli-intern-project/tools/caretaker-agent/evals/pr-generation/run_outputs/large_triaged_3.5_flash/agent_environments/gemini_cli_24480/tmp/pr/gemini-cli/packages/core/src/sandbox/windows/WindowsSandboxManager.ts):**
   - Standardized path comparisons to use the robust `resolveToRealPath` and `isSubpath` utilities.
   - Updated `grantLowIntegrityAccess` logic using `icacls`, where we now explicitly grant `Modify (M)` permissions to the Low Integrity SID (`*S-1-16-4096`) alongside low-integrity tagging.
   - Deferred the removal of forbidden manifests to clean up *after* sandboxed process termination using the `cleanup` callback field of `SandboxedCommand`.

3. **Stablized Tests on Windows in [sandboxManager.integration.test.ts](file:///usr/local/google/home/joneba/ssr-prototype/gcli-intern-project/tools/caretaker-agent/evals/pr-generation/run_outputs/large_triaged_3.5_flash/agent_environments/gemini_cli_24480/tmp/pr/gemini-cli/packages/core/src/services/sandboxManager.integration.test.ts):**
